gold.title: Strategy interface + factory + options type for a single implementation with one caller — a plain function does the job
gold.description: The change builds a DiscountStrategy interface, a BulkDiscountStrategy class, a DiscountStrategyFactory, and a factory-options type, all to apply one discount rule from one call site (applyBulkDiscount, consumed only by checkoutTotal). A single plain function holds the whole rule; the abstraction has no second implementation and no second consumer.

candidate.title: Strategy interface + factory scaffolding, one consumer each
candidate.description: Four exported types (DiscountStrategy, DiscountStrategyFactory, DiscountStrategyFactoryOptions, BulkDiscountStrategy) encode a plug-in point with no second implementation and no external caller. Collapse to function plus two constants.

gold.title: Defensive null/undefined check on a number-typed parameter the type system makes impossible
gold.description: applyBulkDiscount(total: number) guards total === null || total === undefined, states its own signature already rules out. Dead defense: the branch cannot execute from any typed caller.

candidate.title: Null/undefined guard on a parameter typed `number`
candidate.description: Unreachable guard on parameter typed number; type signature guarantees non-null number. Delete lines 36-38.
